+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1',
+                    'status': ['preview'],
+                    'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = """
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+author: "Ansible Project"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Manage syslog hosts, console and buffered logging, persistence, RFC5424
+    format, the global logging switch, and the syslog facility on ICX devices.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description:
+      - Logging destination or feature to manage. Use C(facility) without a
+        destination to manage only the syslog facility.
+    type: str
+    choices: ['on', 'host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'facility']
+  name:
+    description:
+      - Host name or IPv4/IPv6 address of the syslog server. Required for C(dest=host).
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description:
+      - UDP port of the syslog server. Applies only to C(dest=host).
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description:
+      - Syslog facility. It is a global setting and can be specified with a
+        destination or by itself. C(state=absent) resets it to C(user).
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description:
+      - Logging level. Required for C(dest=buffered). Buffered logging accepts
+        one level or a list of levels. Console logging accepts one level.
+    type: raw
+  aggregate:
+    description:
+      - List of logging settings to manage in one call. Each entry can override
+        C(state) and the other top-level options.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+    suboptions:
+      dest:
+        description: Logging destination or feature to manage.
+        type: str
+        choices: ['on', 'host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'facility']
+      name:
+        description: Syslog host name or address.
+        type: str
+      udp_port:
+        description: UDP port for a syslog host.
+        type: int
+      facility:
+        description: Global syslog facility.
+        type: str
+      level:
+        description: Console level or buffered level or list of levels.
+        type: raw
+      state:
+        description: Whether this setting should be present or absent.
+        type: str
+        choices: ['present', 'absent']
+  state:
+    description:
+      - Whether the logging setting should be present or absent.
+    type: str
+    default: present
+    choices: ['present', 'absent']
+  check_running_config:
+    description:
+      - Compare with the running configuration. Can also be set with the
+        C(ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG) environment variable.
+    type: bool
+    default: yes
+"""
+
+EXAMPLES = """
+- name: Configure an IPv6 syslog server
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: host
+    name: 2001:db8::1
+    udp_port: 514
+
+- name: Disable selected buffered levels
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: buffered
+    level: [debugging, informational]
+    state: absent
+
+- name: Set a facility and manage two hosts
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {facility: local7}
+      - {dest: host, name: 192.0.2.1, udp_port: 514}
+      - {dest: host, name: '2001:db8::2', udp_port: 514}
+
+- name: Reset the facility
+  icx_logging:
+    facility: local7
+    state: absent
+
+- name: Disable console logging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: console
+    state: absent
+"""
+
+RETURN = """
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the device, or planned in check mode.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample:
+    - logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514
+"""
+
+import re
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import remove_default_spec, validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+
+LEVELS = ('emergencies', 'alerts', 'critical', 'errors', 'warnings',
+          'notifications', 'informational', 'debugging')
+DESTINATIONS = ('on', 'host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence',
+                'rfc5424', 'facility')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    """Count supplied (non-None) values for the named parameters."""
+    names = check.keys() if param is None else param
+    return sum(check.get(key) is not None for key in names)
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    """Apply destination-specific requirements to a single aggregate entry."""
+    for key, value, required in spec or []:
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            for name in required:
+                if param.get(name) is None or param.get(name) == '':
+                    module.fail_json(msg="%s is required when %s is %s" % (name, key, value))
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for item in lst:
+        if item.get('name') == name:
+            return item
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    """Return levels to enable and levels to disable."""
+    want_levels = set(want)
+    have_levels = set(have)
+    return want_levels - have_levels, have_levels - want_levels
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host' and re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+', line):
+        match = re.search(r'(?:^|\s)udp-port\s+(\d+)(?=\s|$)', line)
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+(?:ipv6\s+)?(\S+)(?:\s|$)', line)
+        if match and match.group(1) != 'ipv6':
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^\s*logging\s+host\s+ipv6\s+\S+', line))
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    """Normalize single and aggregate parameters without modifying module.params."""
+    keys = ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state')
+    aggregate = module.params.get('aggregate')
+    if aggregate is not None and not aggregate:
+        module.fail_json(msg='aggregate must contain at least one logging setting')
+    entries = aggregate if aggregate is not None else [module.params]
+    obj = []
+
+    for item in entries:
+        entry = {key: item.get(key) if item.get(key) is not None else module.params.get(key)
+                 for key in keys}
+        entry['state'] = entry['state'] or 'present'
+        if count_terms(entry, ('dest', 'facility')) == 0:
+            module.fail_json(msg='one of dest or facility is required')
+        if entry['dest'] not in DESTINATIONS and entry['dest'] is not None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='unsupported logging destination: %s' % entry['dest'])
+        check_required_if(module, required_if, entry)
+
+        if entry['dest'] == 'host':
+            name = entry['name']
+            if not name or re.search(r'\s', name):
+                module.fail_json(msg='name must be a single host name or IP address')
+            if ':' in name and not validate_ip_v6_address(name):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid IPv6 address: %s' % name)
+            entry['addr6'] = validate_ip_v6_address(name)
+            if entry['udp_port'] is not None:
+                try:
+                    port = int(entry['udp_port'])
+                except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                    module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be an integer from 1 to 65535')
+                if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
+                    module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be an integer from 1 to 65535')
+                entry['udp_port'] = str(port)
+        else:
+            entry['name'] = None
+            entry['udp_port'] = None
+            entry['addr6'] = False
+
+        if entry['dest'] == 'buffered':
+            levels = entry['level']
+            if isinstance(levels, (list, tuple, set)):
+                levels = set(levels)
+            else:
+                levels = set([levels])
+            if not levels or not levels.issubset(set(LEVELS)):
+                module.fail_json(msg='level must contain valid buffered logging levels')
+            entry['level'] = levels
+        elif entry['dest'] == 'console':
+            if entry['level'] is not None and entry['level'] not in LEVELS:
+                module.fail_json(msg='level must be a valid console logging level')
+        else:
+            entry['level'] = None
+
+        if entry['dest'] == 'facility' and entry['state'] == 'present' and not entry['facility']:
+            module.fail_json(msg='facility is required when dest is facility and state is present')
+        if entry['facility'] == '':
+            module.fail_json(msg='facility must not be empty')
+        obj.append(entry)
+    return obj
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    """Read the logging portion of the running config into normalized objects."""
+    data = get_config(module, flags=['| include logging'],
+                      compare=module.params.get('check_running_config'))
+    obj = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    on = True
+    buffered = False
+    buffered_all = False
+    buffered_adds = set()
+    buffered_removes = set()
+    console = None
+    persistence = False
+    rfc5424 = False
+
+    for raw_line in data.splitlines():
+        line = raw_line.strip()
+        if line.startswith('logging host '):
+            name = parse_name(line, 'host')
+            if name:
+                obj.append(dict(dest='host', name=name, udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                                facility=None, level=None, addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[2]
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+        elif line == 'no logging on':
+            on = False
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            on = True
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = True
+            buffered_all = True
+        elif line == 'no logging buffered':
+            buffered = True
+            buffered_all = False
+            buffered_adds.clear()
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered = True
+                buffered_adds.add(level)
+                buffered_removes.discard(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffered = True
+                buffered_removes.add(level)
+                buffered_adds.discard(level)
+        elif line == 'logging console' or line.startswith('logging console '):
+            parts = line.split()
+            console = parts[2] if len(parts) == 3 and parts[2] in LEVELS else None
+            obj = [item for item in obj if item['dest'] != 'console']
+            obj.append(dict(dest='console', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            facility=None, level=console, addr6=False,
+                            disabled_levels=set()))
+        elif line == 'no logging console':
+            obj = [item for item in obj if item['dest'] != 'console']
+        elif line.startswith('no logging console '):
+            parts = line.split()
+            if len(parts) == 4 and parts[3] in LEVELS:
+                existing = next((item for item in obj if item['dest'] == 'console'), None)
+                if existing is not None:
+                    existing['disabled_levels'].add(parts[3])
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            persistence = True
+        elif line == 'no logging persistence':
+            persistence = False
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            rfc5424 = True
+        elif line == 'no logging enable rfc5424':
+            rfc5424 = False
+
+    if buffered:
+        levels = (set(LEVELS) if buffered_all else set()) | buffered_adds
+        levels -= buffered_removes
+        obj.append(dict(dest='buffered', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                        facility=None, level=levels, addr6=False))
+    for dest, enabled in (('persistence', persistence), ('rfc5424', rfc5424), ('on', on)):
+        if enabled:
+            obj.append(dict(dest=dest, name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            facility=None, level=None, addr6=False))
+    obj.append(dict(dest='facility', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                    facility=facility, level=None, addr6=False))
+    return obj
+
+
+def _host_command(host, absent=False):
+    command = 'logging host '
+    if host.get('addr6'):
+        command += 'ipv6 '
+    command += host['name']
+    if host.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port ' + str(host['udp_port'])
+    return 'no ' + command if absent else command
+
+
+def _ordered_levels(levels):
+    return [level for level in LEVELS if level in levels]
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    """Compute commands and update an in-memory state for aggregate entries."""
+    want, have = updates
+    current = deepcopy(have)
+    commands = []
+
+    for entry in want:
+        dest = entry.get('dest')
+        state = entry.get('state', 'present')
+        facility = entry.get('facility')
+
+        if facility is not None or dest == 'facility':
+            current_facility = next((item for item in current if item['dest'] == 'facility'), None)
+            if current_facility is None:
+                current_facility = dict(dest='facility', facility='user')
+                current.append(current_facility)
+            if state == 'present' and facility != current_facility['facility']:
+                commands.append('logging facility ' + facility)
+                current_facility['facility'] = facility
+            elif (state == 'absent' and current_facility['facility'] != 'user' and
+                  (facility is None or facility == current_facility['facility'])):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+                current_facility['facility'] = 'user'
+
+        if dest is None or dest == 'facility':
+            continue
+
+        if dest == 'host':
+            hosts = [item for item in current if item['dest'] == 'host' and
+                     item.get('addr6') == entry.get('addr6')]
+            matching = search_obj_in_list(entry['name'], hosts)
+            same_name = [item for item in hosts if item['name'] == entry['name']]
+            if state == 'absent':
+                for item in same_name:
+                    if entry.get('udp_port') is None or entry['udp_port'] == item.get('udp_port'):
+                        commands.append(_host_command(item, absent=True))
+                        current.remove(item)
+            elif matching is None or not any(item.get('udp_port') == entry.get('udp_port')
+                                             for item in same_name):
+                for item in same_name:
+                    commands.append(_host_command(item, absent=True))
+                    current.remove(item)
+                commands.append(_host_command(entry))
+                current.append(deepcopy(entry))
+            continue
+
+        existing = next((item for item in current if item['dest'] == dest), None)
+        if dest == 'buffered':
+            active = set(existing['level']) if existing is not None else set()
+            levels = entry['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, active)
+                for level in _ordered_levels(adds):
+                    commands.append('logging buffered ' + level)
+                active |= adds
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(active - levels, active)
+                for level in _ordered_levels(removes):
+                    commands.append('no logging buffered ' + level)
+                active -= removes
+            if existing is None:
+                current.append(dict(dest='buffered', level=active))
+            else:
+                existing['level'] = active
+        elif dest == 'console':
+            level = entry.get('level')
+            disabled = existing.get('disabled_levels', set()) if existing is not None else set()
+            if state == 'present' and (existing is None or
+                                       (level is not None and
+                                        (existing.get('level') != level or level in disabled))):
+                commands.append('logging console' + (' ' + level if level else ''))
+                if existing is None:
+                    current.append(dict(dest='console', level=level, disabled_levels=set()))
+                else:
+                    existing['level'] = level
+                    disabled.discard(level)
+            elif state == 'absent' and existing is not None:
+                if level is None:
+                    commands.append('no logging console')
+                    current.remove(existing)
+                elif level not in disabled and existing.get('level') in (None, level):
+                    commands.append('no logging console ' + level)
+                    existing.setdefault('disabled_levels', set()).add(level)
+        else:
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging ' + dest
+            if state == 'present' and existing is None:
+                commands.append(command)
+                current.append(dict(dest=dest))
+            elif state == 'absent' and existing is not None:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+                current.remove(existing)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='raw'),
+        state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']),
+    )
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+    argument_spec = dict(
+        aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+        check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                  fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])),
+    )
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    required_if = [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, required_if)
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    result = dict(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(**result)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+
+
+class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
+
+    module = icx_logging
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.get_config_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
+        self.get_config = self.get_config_patch.start()
+        self.get_config.return_value = ''
+        self.load_config_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
+        self.load_config = self.load_config_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.get_config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_config_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_updates_facility_and_both_host_families(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = '\n'.join([
+            'logging facility local0',
+            'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+        ])
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(facility='local7'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=1514),
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::2', udp_port=514),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, sort=False, commands=[
+            'logging facility local7',
+            'no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+            'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 1514',
+            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::2 udp-port 514',
+        ])
+
+    def test_host_identity_includes_port_and_ipv6_keyword(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = '\n'.join([
+            'logging host 192.0.2.1',
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514',
+        ])
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=514),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_absent_host_with_port_removes_only_matching_port(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = '\n'.join([
+            'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+            'logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 1514',
+        ])
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=514, state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514'])
+
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=1514))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_buffered_levels_respect_bare_enable_and_disabled_lines(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = '\n'.join([
+            'logging buffered',
+            'no logging buffered debugging',
+            'no logging buffered informational',
+        ])
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='buffered', level=['debugging', 'informational']),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='alerts', state='absent'),
+        ]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, sort=False, commands=[
+            'logging buffered informational',
+            'logging buffered debugging',
+            'no logging buffered alerts',
+        ])
+
+    def test_disabled_buffered_level_is_idempotent(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_facility_reset_and_default_are_idempotent(self):
+        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging facility local7'
+        set_module_args(dict(facility='local7', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging facility'])
